messages.author: c772b73344255d92
messages.subject: renderGvis / gvisTable not rendering
parts:
Hi, I have a shiny app that has some googlevis charts and tables that are giving me some problems.



server.R

foo <- reactive({ switch(input$cycle_two,
"x" = "x",
"y" = "y)})

data.foo <- reactive({ get(paste('df_',foo(),sep="")) })

output$scenarios <- renderUI({
checkboxGroupInput("scenarioChoice", "Scenarios",
c(sort(levels(data.foo()$SCE_NM))),
selected=c("TD_BASE", "TDA_D5"))
})

temp.rows <- reactive({ input$scenarioChoice })

# This works as expected
data.foo.sub <- reactive({ x <- subset(data.foo(), data.foo()$SCE_NM %in% c(temp.rows()))
x <- droplevels(x)
return(x) })

#this is where the problem starts
# If I try to run this with the subsetted dataframe I get no errors but the table will not show on the app
output$gdptab <- renderGvis({ cast.1 <- as.data.frame(cast(data.foo.sub(),PERIOD~SCE_NM,value='FCST_VALUE'))
# plot(gvisTable(cast.1)) if I uncomment this and run the app this shows the table in a new browser as expected
return(gvisTable(cast.1)
})

# if I run this without subsetting the data then it shows on the app as expected
output$gdptab <- renderGvis({ cast.1 <- as.data.frame(cast(data.foo(),PERIOD~SCE_NM,value='FCST_VALUE'))
# plot(gvisTable(cast.1)) if I uncomment this and run the app this shows the table in a new browser as expected
return(gvisTable(cast.1)
})


ui.R

# Main Panel
mainPanel(
tabsetPanel(id="tabs",
tabPanel("Plots",
htmlOutput("gdptab")))))

I have tried casting the data outside the renderGvis, I’ve tried different methods of subsetting the data including subsetting after casted instead of before plus many other combinations trying to make this work. However I’m stumped because I can always get the correct table to show in a different browser using plot(gvisTable(foo)).

Has anyone else witnessed something similar or have any suggestions on how to fix this. I hope I’ve stated my problem clearly but if not please let me know.


Thanks in advance
